lessons: STALE pin bumped: israeli-bank-scrapers 6.7.4 (2026-04-20) -> 6.7.8 (2026-06-15). Only point-release bug fixes since review (6.7.5 leumi, 6.7.6 yahav, 6.7.7 visa-cal, 6.7.8 discount), NO breaking change and NO CompanyTypes enum change. The >=6.7.x pin stays valid; just refresh the 'current release' figure each cycle.

VERIFIED OK (no change): no fabricated CLI (the package is library-only, bin:null) and the prior agorot/OAuth-class traps are absent; the CompanyTypes enum exactly matches the skill's 18 entries (14 banks + 4 card cos), BOI codes consistent, both MCP wrappers live.
Softened il-bank-mcp (glekner): noted it is less actively maintained (last push mid-2025) and pins an older scraper (6.1.4); israeli-bank-mcp (mottibec) is the more current wrapper.

Stripped pervasive PRE-EXISTING em-dashes from the touched files (SKILL.md, SKILL_HE.md, references/supported-banks.md): table-cell BOI 'no code' em-dash -> hyphen, prose ' - ' separators -> commas. The em-dash ban applies to every file touched in an update, not just edited lines.

PIN BUMPED 6.7.8 -> 6.9.0 (2026-07-22). 6.9.0 added Leumi savings accounts and Max credit-card balances, so an older pin silently returns LESS rather than failing. 6.8.0 completed the Visa Cal frame work; 6.7.9 fixed a Max login-page failure and 6.7.10 added an Isracard bot-detection workaround, so anything below 6.7.10 fails outright on those two providers.
CRITICAL FIXED: the categoriser counted pension/hishtalmut/gemel deposits as SPENDING. Total Spending, Into Savings and Total Outflow are now reported separately.

CRITICAL FIXED (my own fix was defeated by pattern order): the insurance patterns (harel/migdal/menora) sat BEFORE the savings patterns in a single first-match dict, so 'הפקדה לקרן פנסיה מגדל' classified as insurance and pension money went straight back into Total Spending. Savings now live in a PRIORITY_PATTERNS table tested first. Lesson: when a fix depends on which of two overlapping rules wins, test the collision case explicitly, not just the happy path.
CRITICAL FIXED: abs(amount) meant refunds, reversals and any incoming credit were counted as spending. Positive amounts are now tracked as credits and excluded from spending, with a Credits In line.
FIXED: percentages divided by the spending-only total while the category rows still included savings, so the column summed to well over one hundred. Now divides by Total Outflow and sums to ~100.

FIXED: Hebrew substring patterns matched inside longer words (פז fired on פזגז, הוט on מלון הוט, מגדל on קניון מגדל שלום). Added a leading Hebrew-letter guard plus explicit trailing guards on the whole-word tokens. NOTE: a blanket trailing guard broke the פנסי stem (it must still match פנסיה) - the guard is deliberately leading-only, with per-pattern trailing guards.
FIXED: category_count used `+= amount and 1`, so a zero-amount transaction was never counted and the counter became a float.
FIXED: top_merchants included savings, contradicting the documented 'top merchants by spending'.
FIXED: --example ignored --output-json, returning an unparseable table to any agent following the documented flag.
ADDED: a credentials and transaction-data handling section in both languages. This skill drives a scraper over live bank usernames, passwords and OTPs and had no handling rule at all.
FIXED: the frontmatter/metadata 'Supports ...' list named 12 banks while the reference said 14 (Behatsdaa and Beyahad Bishvilha were missing).
VERIFIED: CompanyTypes enum is 18 entries and references/supported-banks.md matches it exactly, including pagi.
carry: Keyword categorisation still mis-assigns genuinely ambiguous Hebrew names: קניון מגדל שלום (a mall) hits the insurer מגדל, and מלון הוט (a hotel) hits the cable company הוט. Documented as a limitation in both languages; a merchant-ID or MCC-based approach would be the real fix.

Unsourced claims still in the body: the Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 basis for Israeli Open Banking; the per-bank history-depth claim (Hapoalim/Leumi <12 months, FIBI group 12+); session lifetimes of ~15-30 minutes and OneZero's OTP setup; bank ownership/positioning notes (Yahav owned by Hapoalim, Massad education sector, Pagi Charedi-focused); and the il-bank-mcp last-push date and its 6.1.4 pin. Source or hedge each next cycle.
The phrase 'a substantial share' for typical Israeli payslip savings deductions is unsourced; either cite a BTL/pension figure or drop the quantifier.

lessons: CRITICAL FIXED: categorize_transactions.py built output with {**txn}, so every field the upstream feed carried (account number, card identifier, asmachta, memo) was printed by --output-json. That contradicted the skill's own rule against repeating a card number 'even partially'. Now an explicit allowlist of date/description/amount/category/is_credit.

ADDED (biggest gap): an integrity section in both languages. The skill had a confidentiality section (do not leak credentials out) and nothing telling the agent that merchant descriptions are attacker-controllable input that must never be followed as instructions. Transfer reference fields and Bit notes mean anyone who can send the user a shekel can place text on their statement.

FIXED: the frontmatter said 'Requires ... MCP server' while Step 1 offered a no-MCP path and the bundled script has zero MCP dependency. compatibility now states the split (analysis standalone, retrieval needs MCP), metadata.json mcp-server became mcp-servers plus mcp-required: false, and Step 1 stopped promising CSV/Excel import that is not implemented.

FIXED: 2FA troubleshooting said 'one-time setup per session' while references/supported-banks.md said sessions expire in 15-30 minutes. Reconciled, and added guidance to approve only OTP prompts tied to an action just requested, since training reflexive approval of unsolicited bank prompts is how account takeover works.

REFRAMED: il-bank-mcp staleness was described as a capability caveat. Its committed yarn.lock pins israeli-bank-scrapers to exactly 6.1.4 (2025-06-09), which predates v6.7.9 (max login), v6.7.10 (isracard bot detection) and v6.8.0 (visa-cal frames), so those three do not work at all. An unmaintained dependency holding bank credentials is a security consideration.

UPSTREAM FINDING (not fixable in this skill): israeli-bank-mcp returns JSON.stringify(result) from getLongTermTwoFactorToken, and the upstream type ScraperGetLongTermTwoFactorTokenResult carries longTermTwoFactorAuthToken, so a persistent bank credential enters the transcript. It also returns the whole scrapeResult unfiltered, which is the upstream source of the {**txn} leak. The skill now warns not to repeat raw fields back.

ADDED: data-lifecycle guidance (state export paths, keep exports out of synced folders, the SQLite store is unencrypted and how to purge it) and a qualitative terms-of-service and fraud-liability caution pointing at the BOI consumer enquiries page. No BOI directive number asserted, since none was fetched.
carry: allowed-tools is still not set on this skill, while israeli-crypto-tax-reporter and israeli-tax-returns do set it. It was left off deliberately this cycle: Step 2 is entirely mcp__* tool calls and it was not established whether allowed-tools gates MCP tools. A naive Bash(python:*) list could disable the skill's core function. Verify the interaction, then add it; without WebFetch and Write the injection scenario loses its exfiltration path.
The '~15-30 minute' session lifetime is still unsourced and the 2FA guidance now leans on it harder than before. Source or hedge next cycle.
Still unsourced from earlier cycles: the Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 basis for Israeli Open Banking; the per-bank history-depth claim; bank ownership and positioning notes.

No CSV or Excel ingest exists. Step 1 now tells the user to convert to JSON rather than promising an import that is not implemented. Implementing a converter would make the credential-free path genuinely usable and would also serve as a fallback when a scraper breaks, which happens roughly monthly.
